messages:
katie: quick sync — product wants a single reliability dashboard for inference errors (timeouts / 5xx / OOM / degraded-mode fallbacks). Can eng-platform + runtime + router agree on the exact metrics we need and where they come from by EOD?

mike: scope question — are we building a console-level dashboard (per-customer/per-route) or a global infra one first?

katie: both. MVP is infra/global view + per-route top offenders. product will iterate after we have stable signals.

sasha: ok. Source plan: runtime should emit counters for request outcomes; router should emit fallback counters and reasons; quota service should emit rejections. Also record sample traces for latencies + timeout reasons.

mike: proposed metric names (Prometheus-style) — pls comment if these collide with existing names:
```
inference_request_total{result="ok|timeout|5xx|oom|fallback", model_family="...", pool="...", region="...", priority="..."}
inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{...}
inference_fallback_invocations_total{fallback_target="model-v2|small-embed|hosted", fallback_reason="latency|oom|cap"}
inference_degraded_mode_enter_total{reason="kv_miss|slow_storage"}
quota_rejection_total{reason="rate_limit|quota_exceeded"}
```

raj: cardinality risk here. We should enforce aggregation keys: model_family (not full model id), pool, region, and priority. No per-customer tags in infra dashboard — we can surface per-customer in a separate view if needed.

anya: console UX notes — want: (1) single-pane top-level error rate + timeouts, (2) heatmap by pool x region, (3) drilldown to route with top 5 failing prompts/models, (4) trend comparison vs baseline. Also need obvious links to sample traces / logs.

mike: implementation plan: runtime team adds the request outcome counter + latency histograms; router adds fallback counters and reasons; quota team surfaces rejection metric. Emit with low-cardinality labels: model_family, pool, region, priority. We'll also add a "fallback_chain" label (short) for quick grouping.

sasha: for fallback_chain, keep it limited: e.g., "primary->small-model"; avoid user ids.

mike: telemetry path: metrics -> Prometheus remote write -> metrics-store. Logs -> Loki. Traces -> Tempo. We'll add a link-id in logs/metrics (trace_id) so console can jump to traces. Sampling at 0.5% for successful calls, 100% for errors.

raj: alerting thoughts — SLOs should be on successful requests and latency p95. For errors, create paging alerts only for sustained anomalies (e.g., 5% 5xx over 5m AND +200% above baseline). Timeouts and OOMs -> severity high. Fallback counts -> warn.

katie: product ask: include fallback success rate (how often fallback produced usable output) — we probably need an eval signal or client-side ack. Can we add a fallback_success_total metric?

sasha: we can emit fallback_outcome{success="true|false"} from the router if we can determine success (best-effort). If not, mark as unknown and surface in product follow-up.

mike: small example Grafana panels I will prototype:
- Global error rate line (stacked by result)
- Heatmap (pool x region) of timeout rate
- Top 10 routes by 5xx rate table with sparklines
- Fallbacks per-minute and fallback success ratio
- OOM events timeline with node/pool annotations

anya: also need RBAC for console views — infra vs customer support. Will add wireframes.

raj: data retention note from observability team: metrics retention for high-cardinality labels is 30d; keep that in mind. observability-bot, is there any quota impact?

observability-bot: current remote-write budget has ~15% headroom. Adding the proposed low-cardinality metrics should be fine; high-card labels or traces at 100% error sampling could push over.

mike: action items:
- mike: prototype metrics PR in runtime (add inference_request_total + histograms) — due +3 days
- sasha: router PR for fallback counters + fallback_outcome — due +3 days
- raj: Grafana wireframe + alert proposal — due +4 days
- anya: console wireframe + RBAC notes — due +5 days
- katie: product acceptance criteria + test prompts to validate dashboards — due +6 days

katie: thanks all. If anyone hits cardinality or retention blockers, call it out immediately. We'll aim to demo a working dashboard in next eng review. :thumbsup:

mike: ack, starting instrumenting now.

sasha: ack — will add sane defaults to avoid extra labels.

raj: will draft alert runbook alongside wireframe.

anya: adding a mockup later today. :eyes:

katie: closing loop — I'll schedule a 30m demo next Tuesday. Thanks! :raised_hands:
